user_story: As a user, I want to create a task with a title so that I can track my work.

positive.title: Create task with valid title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
Enter a valid title into the title field (e.g., 'Complete project report')
positive.expected_result: Task is created successfully with the specified title

negative.title: Create task with empty title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
negative.expected_result: Error message is displayed indicating that the title field is required

edge.title: Create task with maximum character title
steps: Navigate to the task creation page
Enter a title with the maximum allowed characters (e.g., 255 characters)
edge.expected_result: Task is created successfully with the maximum character length title
